summary.object_en: Develop, deploy, operate and maintain an AI chatbot for the Canary Islands Government's future support platform against gender-based violence: conversation design, content, model training on approved material, controlled pilot, go-live on secure public cloud, corrective/evolutive maintenance and documentation.
summary.object_es: Desarrollo inicial de un chatbot basado en inteligencia artificial para la futura Plataforma inteligente de apoyo, formación y orientación contra la violencia de género de la Viceconsejería de Justicia y Seguridad, con despliegue en nube pública segura, mantenimiento y gestión de contenidos.

summary.submission: Electronic only through PLACSP, single electronic file. Questions allowed until 4 days before the deadline; answers are binding.

price.formula: P = 60 x (log (mo))/(log(O)); mo = best (lowest) offer, O = offer being scored, log base 10. Max discount 20%.
price.formula_explained_en: Logarithmic formula that compresses price differences: at this budget, even the best allowed discount (20%) only beats a full-price bid by about 1.2 points out of 60. The contract is decided by the 40 quality points, especially the project manager's experience (15) and cloud/ENS certifications (20). Any discount above 20% scores 0 on price.
price.abnormally_low_rule: Presumed abnormally low if more than 20% below the base budget; bidder gets 5 business days to justify. Offers breaching subcontracting, environmental, social or labour rules are rejected.

review_notes: HIGH RISK / LIKELY INCUMBENT: the minimum project-manager requirement (3 years building case-management systems for Gender Violence Courts, p.4) is also the biggest quality criterion (15 pts, p.13). Very few firms have this; it most likely favours the current supplier of Canary Islands justice systems. Check past awards for this buyer before investing in the bid.
TIGHT ECONOMICS: 13 people, 1,398 estimated hours, 50,696.25 € excl. IGIC (p.6), ending 31 Dec 2026 (p.8). If awarded in late October, that leaves about 2 months to build, pilot and go live.

PRICE BARELY MATTERS: log formula + 20% cap (p.14–15) means the price spread is ~1.2 points out of 60. Bid close to budget and compete on certifications, ENS level and the project manager's experience.
UNEVEN CLOUD CRITERION: 'Microsoft Solutions Partner for Microsoft Cloud' is much easier to obtain than AWS Premier Tier with Generative AI Competency, yet both earn the same 10 points (p.9, p.11).

INCONSISTENCIES (boilerplate): clause 5.1 says the budget 'includes IGIC' and 'taxes NOT included' in the same sentence (p.5); clause 13.4 mentions lots although the contract has none (p.1, p.16); the data-processing annex is called both Annex IV and Annex VI (p.21); clause 17.6 refers to 'cláusula 24' (p.20); penalties mention forfeiting a guarantee, but no guarantee is defined.
Prices are in IGIC (Canary Islands tax, 7%), not VAT.
